notes: All USD values are as reported (converted from $ millions to USD). Only figures read directly from SEC filings/XBRL are included; nothing is estimated.
Values tagged 'us-gaap:...' were cross-checked between the XBRL companyfacts API and the filing text.

Gross profit is not an XBRL-tagged line in HPE's income statement (HPE reports cost of products, cost of services and financing cost separately); values are taken from the MD&A / earnings release tables where HPE states 'Gross profit'.
Free cash flow is a company-defined non-GAAP measure: CFO less (investment in PP&E and software assets less proceeds from sale of PP&E), adjusted for FX effect on cash.

FY2023-FY2025 segment data use the FY2025 five-segment structure (Server, Hybrid Cloud, Networking, Financial Services, Corporate Investments and Other). Segment revenue figures are 'Total segment net revenue' which include intersegment revenue (eliminations of $563M/$522M/$333M for FY23/FY24/FY25).

Effective Nov 1, 2025 (FY2026), HPE merged Server, Hybrid Cloud and Financial Services into a new 'Cloud & AI' segment and moved Telco and Instant On into Corporate Investments and Other. FY2026 quarterly segment data use this new three-segment structure and are NOT directly comparable to the FY2025 segment table.
Juniper Networks was acquired July 2, 2025, so FY2025 includes ~4 months of Juniper results; FY2025 operating loss reflects $1,621M impairment charges.
Q3 FY2026 net earnings ($1,540M) include a $444M gain on sale of the remaining H3C equity interest.
